behaviour: Persists the page list next to the elements, encrypted with the room key, without changing what `ciphertext` holds.
rules: encryptPages encrypts JSON.stringify(pages) with encryptData, as encryptElements does. decryptPages returns [] when pagesIv or pagesCiphertext is missing, which is a legacy or older-client document; otherwise it decrypts, JSON.parses and returns the records.
FirebaseSceneVersionCache stores `getSceneVersion(elements) + getPagesVersion(pages)`, so a page-only change is unsaved. `sceneVersion` in the document stays elements only.
saveToFirebase keeps its signature and reads `appState.pages`. It bails on isSavedToFirebase(portal, elements, pages). With no document it creates one with getSyncablePages(pages).

With a document it decrypts stored pages and elements, computes `reconciledPages` with getSyncablePages(reconcilePages(pages, storedPages)), and `reconciledElements` with getSyncableElements(applyPageTombstones(reconcileElements(...as today), reconciledPages)), so delete wins in storage too (FR-27). `transaction.update` writes all five fields.

After the transaction it decrypts the stored scene as today, sets the cache, and returns `{ elements: toBrandedType<RemoteExcalidrawElement[]>(storedElements), pages: storedPages }`, or null where it returns null today.

loadFromFirebase returns `{ elements, pages }` or null where it returns null today. Pages are decrypted raw and not repaired: an empty list means a legacy room, and callers reconcile it with local pages.

behaviour: Collaboration syncs every page and the page list: it reconciles pages with elements on every receive, applies delete-wins, and relays the active page to cursors and followers.
rules: _reconcilePages(remotePages) calls reconcilePages(this.excalidrawAPI.getAppState().pages, remotePages ?? []), stores getPagesVersion of the result in lastBroadcastedOrReceivedPagesVersion, and returns it. A missing remotePages comes from an older client or a legacy room.

handleRemoteSceneUpdate(elements, pages) calls updateScene({ elements: applyPageTombstones(elements, pages), pages, captureUpdate: NEVER }), then loadImageFiles as today. The elements are the whole drawing, so `pages` is always passed.

syncElements(elements, appState): call relayActivePage(appState.activePageId), then broadcastElements(elements, appState.pages), then queueSaveToFirebase. The signature takes `Pick<AppState, "pages" | "activePageId">`.

relayActivePage(pageId) returns when pageId equals lastActivePageId. It stores pageId and returns on the first call, when lastActivePageId was null. Otherwise it broadcasts lastPointerPayload through portal.broadcastMouseLocation when set, and calls relayVisibleSceneBounds(), so remote cursors and followers update without a pointer move (FR-26).
broadcastElements(elements, pages) broadcasts when getSceneVersion(elements) is above the last version, or getPagesVersion(pages) is above lastBroadcastedOrReceivedPagesVersion, and stores both.
getSceneElementsIncludingDeleted on this class returns getAllPagesElementsIncludingDeleted(), so every internal reader and Portal's new-user handler see the whole drawing.
